question: In the Nutrisigma feeding trial on Garole lambs, what was the cost per kg of live weight gain in the T2 group?
rendered:
Document: Impact of Nutrisigma on performance of young Garole lambs

The cost per kg of live weight gain in the T2 group was calculated as follows:

Total cost of ration = Cost of concentrate mixture + Cost of Nutrisigma
Total cost of ration = 472.50 (Control) = 472.50 (T1) = 703.50 (T2)
Total weight gain = 2.25 (Control) = 3.46 (T1) = 3.48 (T2)

Cost per kg of gain = Total cost of ration / Total weight gain

For T2 group:
Cost per kg of gain = 703.50 / 3.48 = 202.16
